title: Recent Trends in Personalized Dialogue Generation: A Review of Datasets, Methodologies, and Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the distribution of languages across existing personalized dialogue datasets, highlighting the heavy dominance of English and the significantly limited size of multilingual or translated datasets.

Analyzing the data collection sources and conversational contexts of datasets (e.g., judicial forums, QA subreddits, live streams) to assess how specific platform environments restrict the open-domain nature of personalized dialogue generation.
